summary:
Implemented a shared iPhone navigation/reliability slice plus Quick Sheet and Diagnostics routing improvements.

- Added Diagnostics direct routes to First Checks and Call Summary.
- Added Quick Sheet no-start critical card plus Contact, Live Session, and Dispatch Pack jump targets.
